text:
maria_ops: Heads-up — vendor (GlacierTech) just flagged a partial DOA on 8 units from the EU allocation. They say customs held the pallet ~48h and thermal logs show brief over-temp spikes on 3 units. Requesting RMA and replacement ETA.
vincent_procurement: Ugh. Which SKUs? EU pool or global spot?
maria_ops: SKUs H200-XL, serials attached in vendor email. This was booked against our FRA dedicated pool 2Q commit.
anya_sre: Quick note — if we lose 8 H200s in FRA, our latency SLO for region-narrow workloads will be impacted. We have two high-throughput clusters pinned to that pool. Need a mitigation plan asap.
kai_logistics: I asked for AWB and depot photos. GlacierTech gave AWB 1Z999EEU and a photo link (s3://glaciertech/claims/1717254329). They've opened RMA RT-8421.
maria_ops: GlacierTech offered either: 1) air-replace 3 units (expedite, +$12k unit premium) 2) ground rework with depot (7-10d) 3) credit + reallocate from our US buffer (cross-region transfer).
vincent_procurement: Price delta is painful but predictable. Leo, any flexibility in emergency procurement budget?
leo_finance: We have a small contingency for critical infra, but need justification. Show impact on committed SLA/revenue ops.
anya_sre: Impact: with current traffic and burst profiles, losing 8 H200s would increase 95p tail latency by ~18-25% on the FRA clusters during peak micro-bursts. That risks SLO violations on two premium customers. If we reallocate from US, expect +15-25ms p50 to those customers due to cross-region routing — depends on routing policy.
vincent_procurement: Can we spin up temporary Dedicated capacity in AMS region (closer) instead of shipping from US? Any inventory?
kai_logistics: AMS inventory minimal. I've pinged two APAC/EU vendors for emergency top-up quotes. GlacierTech can air-split 3 now, and next batch in 9 days. Another vendor (NordicCompute) replied with 5 units available but needs 72h to stage and 5d transit.
maria_ops: For rollback policies — we should prefer air-replace for critical customers and route lower-priority workloads to US buffer.
anya_sre: Agree. Also we can enable model fallback to a quantized variant to reduce memory pressure for a week while replacements arrive. Ops note: adjust batching thresholds to avoid KV cache blowouts during limited capacity.
vincent_procurement: Cost tradeoff: air-replace adds ~$36k but prevents SLA credits and churn. Depot rework saves ~$20k but takes 7-10 days risk window. NordicCompute option is middle-of-road.
leo_finance: If SLA breach probability > 60% we approve emergency spend. Any estimate on breach probability?
anya_sre: With current traffic forecast, probability ~70% during next 14 days without mitigation. With 3 air-replaced + US buffer re-route, drops to ~15%.
kai_logistics: GlacierTech sent serial photos and thermal CSV for the affected units. RMA RT-8421 accepted; estimated dock receipt ETA(air) 48-72h after ship. I'll request expedited customs clearance (we'll need paperwork signed).ma_bot: RMA RT-8421 status: CREATED -> AWAITING_PICKUP. Actions needed: "customsForm_signed", "inspector_photos_received".
maria_ops: Kai — please attach signed customs form by EOD, I'll approve the expedite premium from ops contingency if finance signs off.
vincent_procurement: I'll cut PO amendment for air-replace on the 3 units and reserve NordicCompute lead-time for +5 if GlacierTech fails.
leo_finance: Approving up to $40k contingency for this incident conditional on annotated impact doc and final invoices.
anya_sre: Ops checklist: 1) enable quantized fallback for FRA clusters 2) adjust batching windows + KV TTL 3) mark two premium customers for priority routing to any available pool 4) update incident dashboard with capacity delta. I'll do (1)-(3) now.
maria_ops: I'll coordinate with ENG-Platform to update routing policy and with Solutions to notify affected customers privately.
kai_logistics: Uploaded signed customs form (s3://redwood/shipments/1717254329/customs_signed.pdf) and AWB docs. GlacierTech scheduled pickup 12:30 UTC.
vincent_procurement: PO amendment created: PO-3087-EMG. Sharing here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PO-3087
leo_finance: Good. Maria, file the impact note in the procurement incident doc and tag me.
maria_ops: Will do.
anya_sre: Quick perf note — after enabling fallback, p95 tail reduced by ~12% in our test canary. We'll keep the fallback for 10 days and reevaluate when replacements land.
kai_logistics: GlacierTech updated RMA RT-8421 -> IN_TRANSIT. AWB 1Z999EEU shows departure FRA hub. ETA to depot 2024-05-05 09:00 CEST.
vincent_procurement: NordicCompute still holding 5 units until EOD. I'll confirm hold only if GlacierTech misses ETA.
maria_ops: OK closing loop — primary plan: air-replace 3 units (GlacierTech), re-route low-priority jobs to US buffer, enable quantized fallback, reserve NordicCompute as fallback. Logging action items in the incident channel. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
